key.name: language
key.summary: Language of the notch and the preferences window

key.name: theme
key.summary: Look of the notch and the dock: dark, light, or following GNOME's dark mode

key.name: accent
key.summary: Accent color of active toggles, switches and highlights

key.name: dock-autohide
key.summary: Hide the dock when windows overlap it

key.name: dock-size
key.summary: Dock height in pixels (sets the icon size)

key.name: dock-margin
key.summary: Space between the dock and the bottom of the screen

key.name: dock-icon-spacing
key.summary: Space on each side of a dock icon

key.name: dock-plate-padding
key.summary: Space between the dock icons and the edge of the glass

key.name: dock-zoom
key.summary: Magnify dock icons under the pointer

key.name: dock-glass-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the dock's glass plate

key.name: notification-seconds
key.summary: How long a notification stays in the notch

key.name: status-seconds
key.summary: How long the clicked status stays open

key.name: spotlight-on-type
key.summary: Typing in the overview (after Super) opens the notch's search instead

key.name: search-files
key.summary: Spotlight also searches file and folder names (needs the zorin-notchd daemon)

key.name: search-content
key.summary: Spotlight also searches the text inside documents (needs the zorin-notchd daemon)

key.name: show-media
key.summary: Music in the notch: equalizer on the line while a player plays, and its controls on hover

key.name: agent-permissions
key.summary: Claude Code permission prompts can be answered on the notch (needs the zorin-notchd daemon)

key.name: agent-indicator
key.summary: Animation on the standby line while an agent works

key.name: agent-color
key.summary: Color of the agent animation on the standby line

key.name: show-agents
key.summary: Show coding agents (Claude Code, opencode) in the notch

key.name: show-system
key.summary: CPU load and temperature in the status row or the top bar; a click opens the detail (needs the zorin-notchd daemon)

key.name: system-items
key.summary: What the top bar shows of the system: cpu-load, cpu-temp, gpu, memory, ssd-temp, network

key.name: system-graph
key.summary: Small bars of the CPU load next to its number in the top bar

key.name: system-interval
key.summary: Seconds between system info updates

key.name: system-temp-warning
key.summary: CPU temperature (°C) that turns the dot red and gives one notification

key.name: system-temp-notify
key.summary: Notify when the CPU stays above the temperature warning

key.name: system-temp-repeat
key.summary: Minutes before a heat notification may come again

key.name: system-panel-style
key.summary: Background of the system detail panel

key.name: system-chart-color
key.summary: Color of the CPU load chart

key.name: bar-mode
key.summary: What shows at the top while the notch rests: the thin line, the status notch, a full menu bar or glass islands

key.name: notch-style
key.summary: Look of the notch: classic line, or liquid (a lens that drops into a bead toward the pointer)

key.name: notch-floating
key.summary: Float the notch below the top edge as a rounded pill

key.name: notch-float-offset
key.summary: Space between a floating notch and the top of the screen

key.name: idle-width
key.summary: Width of the notch line on standby

key.name: idle-height
key.summary: Height of the notch line on standby

key.name: notification-width
key.summary: Width of the notch when it shows a notification

key.name: panel-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the expanded notch panel

key.name: animations
key.summary: Animate the notch (follows GNOME's own animation setting too)
